Maya (People Ops): Quick heads-up: publishing a short handbook clarification today that separates bereavement and compassionate leave, adds 2 short manager examples, and links the accommodations request form. We're requiring a 12-min manager microtraining + 5-question quiz. Companywide ack of the diff by EOM. Links will be pinned.

Jon (People Ops): What's the rollout timeline and who is required?

Maya (People Ops): Announcement goes live now. Managers: mandatory training + quiz, window = 7 business days. ICs: read + ack by EOM. Live Q&A drop-ins (EMEA + APAC) and a recording.

Kaya (HRBP): I'll add a "Manager actions" callout and a short regional note for statutory differences (EU/UK/APAC). I'm also building the manager tracking CSV.

Rafael (Eng Manager): Can we get a manager roster CSV and weekly status that our leads can ingest? SFTP preferable.

ack-bot: Training created: "Leaves - Bereavement vs Compassionate (2026)" Training ID: leaves-2026-11-05. Quiz ID: qz-leaves-2026-11-05. Results webhook: https://api.redwood.internal/training/results/leaves-2026-11-05

Jon (People Ops): CSV columns planned: manager_email,org_unit,team_size,quiz_status,quiz_score,training_viewed,ack_status,ack_ts,region,accommodation_flag,notes

Sven (Legal): Reviewed. This is clarificatory guidance, not a contract amendment. If someone's employment agreement specifically uses different leave terms, flag to me before sending an individualized ack request. Also add a short privacy note to the ack flow.

Maya (People Ops): Pass threshold = 80%. Reminders at day 3 and day 6. Non-completion after 7 business days -> HRBP outreach. Fail twice -> 1:1 with HRBP.

Rafael (Eng Manager): We'll push roster this afternoon and schedule a brief nudge to managers. Can we get an SFTP drop and a weekly Slack DM for stragglers?

Jon (People Ops): Weekly CSV export will be placed at sftp://peopleops-exports.redwood/handbook/leave-update/ every Friday 05:00 UTC. We'll also enable the webhook for near-real-time updates.

Kaya (HRBP): I'll add an "escalation_needed" column for HRBP follow-ups and a free-text notes column for accommodation details.

Maya (People Ops): Action items: Maya publish announcement + pin links (owner); Jon enable exports/webhooks + training setup (owner); Kaya regional callouts + HR review (owner); Sven review contract flags (owner). Deadline: manager window = 7 business days from today. I'll post the manager email template and calendar invites in ~1 hour. :white_check_mark:
